 CBSE Board Exam Date Sheet 2027 Released: Class 10, 12 Exams Begin February 16; Check Key Details
 Watch Live News 
 Advertisement 
 New Delhi: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has released the examination timetable for the 2027 Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations, bringing clarity for lakhs of students preparing for the upcoming academic milestone. According to the schedule announced on November 6, examinations for both classes will begin on February 16, 2027.
 All examinations are scheduled to commence at 10:30 am, giving students a clear timeline to organise their revision and preparation strategies.
 The board has scheduled examinations across 83 subjects for Class 10 and 121 subjects for Class 12. CBSE said the timetable was prepared after considering more than 40,000 subject combinations to minimise clashes between papers chosen by students.
 Important Highlights of CBSE Board Exams 2027
 Date sheet announcement: November 6, 2026
 Class 10 examinations: February 16 to March 9, 2027
 Class 12 examinations: February 16 to April 9, 2027
 Class 10 subjects: 83
 Class 12 subjects: 121
 Exam starting time: 10:30 am
 Why CBSE Considered 40,000 Subject Combinations
 CBSE said considerable planning went into preparing the 2027 examination timetable. The board examined more than 40,000 subject combinations to ensure that students do not face clashes between examinations in subjects they have selected.
 Several factors were considered while preparing the schedule:
 Advertisement 
 Subject combinations: Adequate gaps have been planned between examinations in subjects commonly chosen together.
 Competitive examinations: The likely dates of major entrance examinations for Class 12 students were also considered.
 Examination centre capacity: The number of students appearing at examination centres on a particular day was taken into account.
 School functioning: The timetable was designed to avoid prolonged teacher absences from schools.
 Student convenience: The scheduling process aimed to provide sufficient preparation time between important papers.
 How to Download CBSE Date Sheet 2027
 Students can access the examination timetable by following these steps:
 Visit the official CBSE website: https://www.cbse.gov.in/ 
 Open the Latest @ CBSE section.
 Look for the CBSE Board Examination Date Sheet 2027 notification.
 Select the relevant Class 10 or Class 12 timetable.
 Download the PDF and save it for future reference.
 What Should Students Do Next?
 With the examination schedule now available, students should prepare a subject-wise revision plan, keeping the gaps between examinations in mind. Class 12 students should also consider the expected dates of competitive entrance examinations while planning their preparation.
 Students are advised to download the official timetable and verify the subject-wise dates, paper timings and examination instructions rather than relying solely on general examination schedules.
 The release of the CBSE Date Sheet 2027 gives students a clear preparation timeline for the upcoming board examinations.
